description.tagline: The Puma AC Milan x Slam Jam cap
description.intro: PUMA and AC Milan join forces with Slam Jam to create a collection that fuses football and urban culture. This cap reflects the essence of San Siro and the contemporary style of Milan, becoming an essential accessory for fans.
key_benefits: Exclusive collaboration: AC Milan x Slam Jam design that mixes football and streetwear.
Cotton Material: Comfortable and breathable fabric for daily use.
Structured design: 6-panel cap that offers a comfortable and stable fit.
Adjustable closure: Allows you to easily adapt the cap to different sizes.
